manifest.name: dsh-terminal
manifest.description: Terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness: mounts over the dsh-base profile layer through the dsh plugin mechanism, consuming the host runtime

scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run verify:boundary && pnpm run verify:contract
scripts.release:pack: pnpm run build:release && pnpm run verify && pnpm pack
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run build:release && pnpm run verify

bundle.text:
# The dsh-terminal patch layer over the base bundle: interactive terminal UI
# with no Host, HTTP server, or browser plugin. The startup provider parses
# --resume/--help, then the runner creates (or resumes) an Agent through the
# core registry and drives the ink view. Mirrors the official tui-app bundle
# layer; plugin rows point at this package's own exports.

- id: system-prompt
  config:
    # rc.3 renamed the persona key and dropped the {{cwd}} template variable
    # (unresolved references fail prompt assembly); the working directory now
    # reaches the model as the working-directory service's user context. The
    # fixed harness identity opener stays on (includeHarnessIdentity default).
    personaPrefix: >-
      You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.

# The shared module-reload HMR row stays off; there is no user patch layer
# to keep live in this composition.
- id: hmr
  disabled: true

- id: tools
  config:
    mode: !!js process.env.DSH_TOOLS_MODE

- insert:
    # Official experimental Agent Teams: direct peer messaging into target
    # inboxes (the rc.2 durable mailbox is retired), shared task DAG, and
    # roster (runtime) plus the model-facing tools. Replaces the prior custom
    # star-topology team plugin; dsh-terminal renders the roster and task
    # board from the agentTeam projection, while peer messages reach the
    # transcript as relay-form user/message frames.
    - id: agent-team
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team'
    - id: tool-agent-team
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team'

    # Experimental per-call Auto review: the current agent's model screens each
    # tool call before it runs with Full access. Mirrors the package's own
    # single-row patch; the layer mounts but stays off until a session selects
    # the Auto permission mode (/permission auto).
    - id: auto-review
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review'

    # The model-facing ask_user_question tool. The user-questions service is
    # already mounted by dsh-base; this row adds the tool (legacy blocking
    # mode, the web-app default) whose waterfall the terminal's runner
    # answers with its question overlay. Without an answerer row here the
    # model has no way to ask; without the runner's answerer every ask (and
    # plan-mode's exit_plan_mode review) would fail with NO_PROVIDER.
    - id: tool-ask-user
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'

    # Bare package names: the dsh plugin mechanism installs this package into
    # the profile's node_modules, where the Loader resolves its exports.
    - id: tui-startup
      name: 'dsh-terminal/startup'

    # Reads its startup values from the ordinary tuiStartup provider.
    - id: tui-runner
      name: 'dsh-terminal'
      inject: [tuiStartup]
      config:
        resume: !!js ctx.tuiStartup.resume
        continueLatest: !!js ctx.tuiStartup.continueLatest === true
        cwd: !!js ctx.tuiStartup.cwd

readme.text: DeepSeek Harness 的终端 UI 插件：经官方 dsh 的 profile 插件机制挂载在 `dsh-base` 之上，消费宿主提供的运行时，通过带版本契约的 adapter 边界与上游解耦。

- **纯插件挂载** —— 不自带宿主运行时：官方 `dsh` CLI 提供 launcher 与 base bundle（`dsh-base` 是 profile 的第一层），本包只提供 TUI 插件行（`tui-startup`/`tui-runner`，经 `cordis.patch.yml` insert）与 `dsh.bundle.patch` 元数据。宿主提供的上游运行时全部声明为 peerDependencies。
- **打包发布（esbuild 双变体）** —— UI 依赖（ink/react/commander/string-width 及其传递依赖）在构建期打进 `dist/`；运行时 external 仅 `@deepseek-ai/*` 与 node 内置。两个 experimental agent-team 包与 `dsh-experimental-auto-review` 保持为 dependencies——它们是 `cordis.patch.yml` 的独立 loader 插件行，由宿主从 profile 的 node_modules 加载，绝不进 bundle（防双实例）。同一管线两个变体：dev（`NODE_ENV="development"`，保留 React 警告，日常验证）与 release（`NODE_ENV="production"`，dev 代码物理摇掉，发布）；`scripts/verify-dist.mjs` 自动断言打包边界与变体正确性。
- **Adapter 边界** —— 官方 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包只允许在 `src/dsh-adapter/` 内被 import；UI 与 driver 一律通过 adapter 的类型 re-export 和服务 facade 间接接触上游。`pnpm run verify:boundary` 扫描源码，发现越界 import 即失败。
- **上游契约** —— adapter 消费的所有依赖按 `src/dsh-adapter/contract.ts` 中的版本线精确钉版（当前 `0.2.1-rc.3`；cordis/loader/schemastery 钉在对应已发布版本）。`pnpm run verify:contract` 对漂移直接失败；上游升版时只需升版本线并修 adapter 暴露的 API 差异。

前置条件：官方 `dsh` CLI、`pnpm` 10+、可用终端 TTY、`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`（进程 env 或 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`）。

```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh          # 官方 CLI

dsh --profile dsh-terminal              # 启动新会话
dsh --profile dsh-terminal --resume <id>  # 恢复指定持久化会话
dsh --profile dsh-terminal -c           # 恢复当前工作目录最近创建的会话（--continue 同义）
dsh --profile dsh-terminal --cwd <dir>  # 以 <dir> 为会话工作目录启动（相对路径按启动目录解析；工具执行、模型上下文与状态栏都跟随会话目录，不改启动进程）
dsh --profile dsh-terminal --cwd <dir> -c  # 组合：<dir> 的最近会话（--resume 显式指定时会话自带目录，--cwd 让位）
node bin/dsh-terminal.js                # 或经本包 bin 直通（profile 未初始化时自动引导）
```

会话统一持久化在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions`（默认 `~/.dsh/sessions`）。
输入 `/` 弹出斜杠命令补全菜单（命令来自会话命令注册表，含 `/permission`、`/effort` 等）：继续输入按前缀过滤，`↑`/`↓` 选择，`Tab` 或 `Enter` 补全为 `/name `（补全后再按 `Enter` 才执行），`Esc` 只关菜单、不打断会话。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build            # dev 变体 bundle → dist/（日常迭代装这个）
pnpm run build:release    # release 变体（dev 代码构建期物理摇掉）
pnpm run typecheck

迭代安装：**版本号不变时 `add` 会被 pnpm 跳过（`Already up to date`），必须先 `remove` 再 `add`**：

```sh
pnpm build && pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile dsh-terminal remove dsh-terminal
dsh plugin --profile dsh-terminal add ./dsh-terminal-<版本>.tgz
```

安装后可 `grep -aF "ctx.appExit" ~/.dsh/profiles/dsh-terminal/node_modules/dsh-terminal/dist/index.js` 确认产物就位（bundle 用 `charset: utf8`，中文文案保持字面量，grep 中文亦可）。报错栈要还原到 `src/*.ts` 行号时：

```sh
NODE_OPTIONS=--enable-source-maps dsh --profile dsh-terminal
```

```sh
pnpm run release:pack     # build:release + 全量 verify（typecheck/test/boundary/contract）+ pack，
                          # 杜绝把 dev 变体当 release 发出去
dsh plugin --profile dsh-terminal remove dsh-terminal
dsh plugin --profile dsh-terminal add ./dsh-terminal-<版本>.tgz   # 真机装 release 产物冒烟
